answer: The kernel of the defense is a small time-locked deposit needed to activate each agent identity: the stake sits in escrow, earning nothing, refunded only after N honest epochs of validated work. Like a mesa, sybils face a flat cliff they must scale repeatedly: every fake identity duplicates the deposit, so mounting thousands means locking real capital for months at zero return. The fable ends badly for attackers: early exit forfeits the stake, so identity becomes a lease paid in time and locked value, making cheap sybil floods unprofitable.
